clientId.label: Google OAuth Client ID
clientId.help: OAuth 2.0 client ID from your Google Cloud project.

defaultCalendarId.label: Default Calendar ID
defaultCalendarId.help: Calendar ID to use when none is specified. Defaults to "primary".

maxResults.label: Max Results
maxResults.help: Maximum number of events returned per request.

timeZone.label: Time Zone
timeZone.help: IANA time zone (e.g. America/New_York). Uses calendar default if omitted.
